meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行创建、预览和发布动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用简单的命令制作和分享动画视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and publish animated videos with a command-line tool.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create and share animated videos using simple commands.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 HyperFrames 命令行制作和调整视频:搭建项目、搜索动画效果、预览并渲染成片;遇到构建或渲染失败时也会用它诊断。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作或修改视频(例如新建项目、搜索动画、渲染成片),或需要排查视频构建/渲染失败时,该技能会被触发。用户提到“这个元素”或当前选中内容时,也会查询 Studio 获取上下文。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 新建一个视频项目,用默认示例。
say.note: 运行 init 并生成项目骨架。

say.text: 在动画目录里搜一个逐行显示标题的效果。
say.note: 运行 catalog 搜索并返回可安装项。

say.text: 帮我检查合成、预览最终视频。
say.note: 依次运行 lint、check 和 preview。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to make and edit videos: scaffolding projects, searching animation effects, previewing, and rendering final output. It also diagnoses build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or modify a video (e.g., new project, search animation, render) or diagnose build/render failures. Also when user refers to 'this element' or current selection, Claude queries Studio for context.

say_en.text: Create a new HyperFrames video project with the default example.
say_en.note: Runs init and scaffolds the project.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a headline reveal effect, one line at a time.
say_en.note: Runs catalog search and lists installable moves.

say_en.text: Check my composition and preview the final video.
